title: A Good Name

questions.question: A good name is to be chosen rather than great what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 22:1 (ESV): "A good name is to be chosen rather than great riches,"

questions.question: The rich and the poor meet together; the Lord is the Maker of them all. This means they are what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 22:2 (ESV): "the Lord is the Maker of them all."

questions.question: Train up a child in the way he should go; even when he is old he will not do what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 22:6 (ESV): "even when he is old he will not depart from it."

questions.question: The rich rules over the poor, and the borrower is the slave of the what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 22:7 (ESV): "and the borrower is the slave of the lender."

questions.question: Drive out a scoffer, and strife will go out, and quarreling and abuse will what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 22:10 (ESV): "and quarreling and abuse will cease."

questions.question: The prudent sees danger and hides himself, but the simple go on and suffer for what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 22:3 (ESV): "but the simple go on and suffer for it."

questions.question: The reward for humility and fear of the Lord is riches and honor and what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 22:4 (ESV): "The reward for humility and fear of the Lord is riches and honor and life."

questions.question: Whoever sows injustice will reap calamity, and the rod of his fury will what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 22:8 (ESV): "and the rod of his fury will fail."

questions.question: He who loves purity of heart, and whose speech is gracious, will have the king as his what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 22:11 (ESV): "will have the king as his friend."

questions.question: The sluggard says, "There is a lion outside! I shall be killed in the what?"
questions.explanation: Proverbs 22:13 (ESV): "I shall be killed in the streets!"

questions.question: Thorns and snares are in the way of the crooked; whoever guards his soul will keep far from whom?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 22:5 (ESV): "whoever guards his soul will keep far from them."

questions.question: Whoever has a bountiful eye will be blessed, for he shares his bread with the what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 22:9 (ESV): "for he shares his bread with the poor."

questions.question: The mouth of forbidden women is a deep pit; he with whom the Lord is angry will do what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 22:14 (ESV): "he with whom the Lord is angry will fall into it."

questions.question: Folly is bound up in the heart of a child, but the rod of discipline drives it far from whom?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 22:15 (ESV): "but the rod of discipline drives it far from him."

questions.question: Whoever oppresses the poor to increase his own wealth, or gives to the rich, will only come to what?

key_verse_text: Train up a child in the way he should go; even when he is old he will not depart from it.
